title: Insert Into a Sorted Circular Linked List
description: Insert a value into a circular sorted linked list maintaining the sorted order.
pseudocode:
1. if head is null, create new node, next to itself
2. curr = head
3. while true:
4.   next = curr.next
5.   if (curr.val <= val <= next.val) or (curr.val > next.val and (val >= curr.val or val <= next.val)):
6.     curr.next = newNode(val, next)
7.     break
8.   curr = next
9.   if curr == head: break

steps.note: Initialize curr at the head node (val: 1).
Identify current node (1) and next node (3).
Check if 2 fits between 1 and 3. 1 <= 2 <= 3 is true.
Insert node with value 2 after node with value 1.
